GUIDE TO PGH LABS

Hello! This channel aims to consolidate all essential information regarding the different laboratories in PGH. Listed below are the main laboratories in PGH and the tests they offer. Special instructions for some lab tests are included as well. Information here will be constantly updated to reflect changes that may occur. 

📄 Central Lab (📞3209)
🩸 Blood Bank (📞3214)
🧬 MRL, Medical Research Laboratory (📞3232)
☢️ Nuclear Medicine (📞3152)
🎀 SAGIP (📞 3249)

🚨 Disclaimer: This channel intends to provide a centralized source of information regarding the various labs in PGH. While we strive for accuracy, discrepancies may occur. If you are uncertain about any information provided, please contact the local number of the concerned laboratory for clarification.

Lab Tests in 📄 Central Lab

Divided into several sections

🧪 Clinical Chemistry (📞3212)
🔬 Clinical Microscopy (📞3210)
🩸 Hematology (📞3213)
🦠 Immunopathology (📞3204)
🧫 Microbiology (📞3206)

❓What lab tests can be combined in one blood top? 
Generally, tests can be combined in one blood top for as long as: 
1️⃣ they share the same color of top (❗️except for green tops, need to be separated from each other) 
2️⃣ they are from the same section

Example:
CBC, Na, K, Cl, HbA1c, TSH, PCT, ESR 
How many red and purple tops?

🟣 CBC, ESR (can be combined since both purple top + both from Hematology) 
🔴 Na, K, Cl (can be combined since all red top + all from Clinical Chemistry) 
🟣 HbA1c (although from Clinical Chemistry, HbA1c is purple top, hence needs to be separate) 
🔴 TSH, PCT (can be combined since both red top + both from Immunopathology)

📝 Special Instructions - Processing of Hemoglobin, Serum Protein, Urine Electrophoresis

Hemoglobin Electrophoresis 
🗓 Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8-9 AM
❗️Requirements
🟣-top, 2 mL for HgB Electrophoresis
☑️ Results of CBC, Ferritin, Iron, dTIBC (CBC result not more than 3 days)
☑️ No blood transfusion for the last 3 months

Serum Protein Electrophoresis 
🗓 Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8-9 AM
❗️Requirements
☑️ Informed Clinical Chemistry (📞3212) the day before
☑️ Result of Serum Total Protein 
☑️ Fasting for at least 6 hours
☑️ No Beta Lactams intake (anti-bacterial drug) 3 days before testing
☑️ No X-ray contrast media 3 days before testing
☑️ No anticoagulant treatment (Heparin, Coumadin, Warfarin) within 24 hours before testing

Urine Electrophoresis 
🗓 Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays
❗️Requirements
☑️ Ask for container from Central Labs
☑️ Patient must void 60 ml of the first morning urine
☑️ Must be obtained alongside with urine total protein (total of 2 specimen cups to be obtained)

Other Reminders
💸 Reader's fee of P200 for service patients
🏃‍♂️Relative must be the one to pay and bring the samples to Serum Chemistry Office
☎️ Call Serum Chemistry (3212) a day prior to extraction so they can prepare equipment
